lesson.meaning: To show or display something, often publicly, or to show a particular quality or feeling.
examples: Please exhibit your most recent sales figures during the team meeting.
It's important to always exhibit professionalism when dealing with clients.
The architect will exhibit the new building plans next week.
Even under pressure, she continued to exhibit great composure.
The lawyer asked the witness to exhibit the evidence to the jury.
lesson.memory_tip: Mama's Tip: Think of an 'exhibition' – it's where things are 'exhibited' or *shown* to the public!
